privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: May 2026
privacy.s2Intro: This website uses Umami Analytics, a privacy-friendly analytics service. Umami sets no analytics cookies and stores no personal data on your device. The following data is collected anonymously on each page visit:
privacy.s2Item1: Page visited and time on page
privacy.s2Item3: Device type, operating system, and browser type (User-Agent)
privacy.s2Item4: Approximate origin (country) derived from the IP address; the IP address itself is not stored
privacy.s2Outro: In addition, anonymised interaction events (e.g. song played, social link clicked) are collected to understand how the site is used. To remember your chosen interface language across visits and page refreshes, the site also stores a first-party language-preference cookie and a matching localStorage entry.
privacy.s3Text: Processing is based on our legitimate interest in improving and securely providing the website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). The language-preference cookie and localStorage entry are used strictly to provide the language selected by the user and are treated as technically necessary for this website function.
privacy.s4Text1: Analytics data is processed by Umami Cloud (Umami Software, Inc., USA). The transfer to the USA is based on EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Art. 46(2)(c) GDPR). A Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with Umami has been or will be concluded.
privacy.s4Text2: The website is served via Cloudflare Pages. Cloudflare processes technically necessary connection data for site delivery. For more information see the Cloudflare Privacy Policy.
privacy.s5Text: Anonymised analytics data is stored for a maximum of 24 months and then automatically deleted. The language-preference cookie and localStorage entry remain until they are replaced by a new selection or cleared by the user.
privacy.s6Intro: You have the following rights against us:
privacy.s6Right4: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
privacy.s6ContactText: To exercise your rights, please contact us at
privacy.s6AuthorityText: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority. For Bavaria, this is the
privacy.s6AuthorityName: Bavarian State Office for Data Protection Supervision (LDA)
privacy.s7Text: This website contains links to external services (Spotify, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub, Songsterr). When you visit these sites, their respective privacy policies apply. We have no control over data processing by these third-party providers.
